## Description {#details}

<p>This file provides a pass which clones the current module and runs the provided pass pipeline on the clone.</p>


<p>The optimized module is stored into a global variable in the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">.<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/lto">llvm.lto</a></span> section. Primarily, this pass is used to support the FatLTO pipeline, but could be used to generate a bitcode section for any arbitrary pass pipeline without changing the current module.</p>
